why.title: You talk to the person who builds it
why.description: No agencies or middlemen: I understand your business and answer you myself.

why.title: Fast and ready for Google
why.description: I use the same technology as big companies (Next.js), so your site loads in seconds and is search-optimized from day one.

why.title: Everything is in your name
why.description: The domain, the code and the accounts are yours. You don't depend on me forever.

faq.a: A landing page is ready in 7 to 10 days and a full site in 2 to 3 weeks. Stores and custom systems depend on scope; the exact timeline is in the proposal.
You pay 50% to start and 50% on delivery. Larger projects are split into 3 payments by stage. I accept bank transfer or other methods we agree on.
I help you buy the domain in your name; you pay its yearly cost directly to the provider. Hosting is included in the maintenance plan, or we set it up in an account of yours.
Yes. If you need it, I set up a dashboard so you can edit text, images or products without coding. Bigger changes are covered by the maintenance plan.

faq.q: What do I need to get started?
faq.a: Your logo, copy and photos of your business. If you don't have them, I'll help you prepare them.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside Colombia?
faq.a: Yes. I work remotely with clients across Colombia and abroad.
